qualification: local A05.3 reliability isolation; not A05.3 closure, performance acceptance, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.acceptedBoundary: Raw host-address prediction is independently selectable on each executor. The production PC machine disables direct-chain initiation and publishes neither its generated indirect-branch target cache nor its shadow-return stack to generated execution. Standalone executor use retains the complete predictor path by default.
candidate.preservedBehavior: Ordinary generated execution, Tier-one admission, the physical C block cache, native trace recording and replay, precise fault recovery, and interpreter fallback remain enabled.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Determine whether the intermittent guest corruption and invalid host returns persist after isolating every generated path that consumes a runtime-published raw host code address.
candidate.productionFinding: Two runs of the exact same hashed release runner passed the authenticated seven-workload fixture and powered off. Both receipts record zero direct-chain activity, zero IBTC activity, and zero shadow-return activity while native trace replay remains active. This accepts the isolation as a production reliability boundary and makes one or more raw-target predictor paths the leading suspect; it does not identify a specific predictor or prove sole causality.

verification.focused: Six tests passed: the new predictor-off state-equivalence regression plus the existing direct-chain, generated IBTC, shadow-return, and cache invalidation paths.
verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,556 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled; the environment-driven pinned boot test skipped because its variables were absent, then the same pinned inputs were executed explicitly twice.

retainedBaseline.reason: The isolation deliberately disables every raw-target bypass, so its zero bypass share is not performance evidence and cannot replace the last accepted enabled-path measurement.

disposition.reason: The two exact-binary runs accept the fail-closed production boundary. A05.3 remains open because direct chaining, IBTC, and shadow returns must be reintroduced independently, each with targeted tests and two frozen-fixture runs, and the final enabled path must exceed 95-percent dispatcher avoidance.

limitations: Two passing local runs are a bounded reliability check, not cross-host qualification or proof that all intermittent failures have been eliminated.
The combined result with the preceding native-trace-off rejection implicates raw host-address prediction, but binary layout and an unobserved correlated defect remain possible confounders.
This diagnostic isolation removes the A05.3 acceleration paths from the production PC default and therefore cannot satisfy their performance gate.
The raw diagnostic receipts remain in the local fixture directory; this checked-in record binds their hashes and selected counters.
